stories.headline: Nvidia adds about $952 billion in a day as its board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.dek: Shares rose 31.48%. The board says US officials told it his return poses no national security risk. Its own probe continues.

facts.text: Nvidia's rise on Nov 23, to $165.05, its largest one-day percentage gain in more than two decades
market value added, to about $3.98T from about $3.03T on Friday, which Fox News called the largest one-day gain in history
board vote to reinstate Huang, effective immediately. Huang resigned on Nov 12 and Nvidia gave no reason; CFO Colette Kress was interim CEO and stays CFO
Huang's closed-door interview before three House committees, including Intelligence. General counsel Tim Teter follows the next day

open.label: Unresolved
open.text: A committee of independent directors is still investigating reports that Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort, with no end date. Trump said he convinced the board. The reported SEC accounting review is also unresolved.

stories.headline: Nasdaq jumps 6.51%, its best day since April 2025, as AI stocks rebound with Nvidia
stories.dek: The S&P 500 rose 4.74% and left correction territory after seven straight losses. PCE inflation data comes Wednesday.

facts.text: the Nasdaq Composite's gain, to 24,090, its best day since April 2025 and its biggest gain this year
the S&P 500's rise, to 7,238, after seven straight losing days. The Dow rose 3.01%, to 49,595
CoreWeave's rise. Dell gained 20.46%, Nebius 20.28% and Micron 19.04%
how far the Nasdaq Composite sat below its peak after Friday's close, before Monday's rally

open.label: Will it hold
open.text: Monday recovered only part of the slide. PCE inflation data on Wednesday will shape Fed expectations, and markets close Thursday for Thanksgiving and early on Friday.

stories.headline: CrowdStrike agrees to buy Zscaler for about $43.9 billion in stock
stories.dek: CrowdStrike says its product for securing AI agents passed $100 million in annual recurring revenue in its first year.

facts.text: the value CrowdStrike's all-stock offer puts on Zscaler, announced with its quarterly results
CrowdStrike shares for each Zscaler share
annual recurring revenue of Falcon Guardian, which secures AI agents, in its first year, CEO George Kurtz said
Zscaler's rise on Monday, while CrowdStrike fell 8.92% on a day the Nasdaq rose 6.51%

open.label: Not closed
open.text: The deal needs regulatory approvals and a Zscaler shareholder vote. CrowdStrike's release gives no expected closing date or premium.

stories.headline: Amazon signs a deal for Decart's AI chip software and team, valued at $7.5B by Calcalist
stories.dek: Amazon is buying the technology and hiring the founders, not buying the company, and gave no price. Decart was valued near $4B in May.

facts.text: Amazon announced it signed an agreement to buy the technology behind the Decart Optimization Stack and bring over the founders and team
the deal's value in cash and stock paid in installments, Calcalist reported. Amazon did not disclose a price
the frame-rate gain over baseline Decart claims on Amazon's Trainium chips. Its software tunes kernels, compilers and runtime to each chip
Decart's valuation in May, when it raised $300M in a round that included Nvidia

open.label: Not closed
open.text: Completion needs regulatory clearance, and the price comes from Calcalist's reporting, not from Amazon.

stories.headline: Anthropic slips 1.43% to $87.64 on the Nasdaq's best day since April 2025
stories.dek: ANT opened higher, then swung between $84.61 and $94.24. It closed about 5.6% above its $83 IPO price.

facts.text: ANT's close on Nov 23, down $1.27 or 1.43%, while Nvidia rose 31.48%
ANT's gain at the open, before it turned lower. The day's range was $84.61 to $94.24
how far the close sits above the $83 IPO price, and well below the $97.17 first-day close
when FTSE Russell will add Anthropic after the close, if it meets fast entry rules

open.label: No clear reason
open.text: Our sources cite no company news behind the drop. The Fool's writer tied it to Washington's interest in open-weight AI, which is his reading, not a reported cause.

stories.headline: Oracle says its OpenAI contract is fully funded after a $20 billion stock and debt sale
stories.dek: Oracle borrowed at 7% to 8.65% and expects free cash flow to turn positive only in the second half of fiscal 2028.

facts.text: of common stock Oracle sold at $116 a share, 86,206,897 shares, closing Nov 4
of notes in five maturities from 2029 to 2046, with coupons from 7.000% to 8.650%
free cash flow Oracle targets for fiscal 2029, after it turns positive in the second half of fiscal 2028
of extra US capacity Oracle plans beyond its Abilene site, Reuters reported. Shares rose as much as 3.3% after hours

open.label: Unstated
open.text: Oracle's statement gives no contract value or length, and its filings say the proceeds are for general corporate purposes, not earmarked for OpenAI.

stories.headline: Sierra raises $1.75 billion at a $30 billion valuation, about double its May price
stories.dek: The maker of customer-service agents said in October it had passed $400 million in annual recurring revenue.

facts.text: the Series F Sierra announced Monday, led by Greenoaks and Lightspeed, with Benchmark, Sequoia, GV and Tiger Global taking part
its new valuation, up from more than $15B in May, when it raised $950M
annual recurring revenue Sierra disclosed in October, after adding more than $150M in the third quarter
the valuation as a multiple of that run rate (derived: $30B divided by $400M)

open.label: Run rate
open.text: Recurring revenue is an annualized figure, not revenue already earned. The round figures come from Sierra's announcement, as reported by IBTimes.

stories.headline: Cognition is in talks to raise $2 billion or more at a $75 billion valuation, Bloomberg says
stories.dek: The maker of the Devin coding agent was valued at $48 billion in September and $26 billion in May.

facts.text: the potential valuation, people familiar with the talks told Bloomberg. Talks are ongoing and details could change
Cognition's valuation in its September Series E of more than $2B, led by Andreessen Horowitz and Accel
Devin's run-rate revenue by September, up from $492M in May, per Cognition's disclosures
the rise over the September valuation (derived: $75B divided by $48B)

open.label: Unconfirmed
open.text: Cognition did not respond to Reuters, and no lead investor has been named.

stories.headline: Citi and PNC join banks making customers liable for what AI agents do with their logins
stories.dek: Customers who give outside agents their logins carry the risk, even after a hack. ChatGPT Wallet pays with a network token instead.

facts.text: changed its online user agreement this week: customers are responsible for what third-party AI agents do with their credentials, even if the tool is hacked. Citi's own agents add no such liability
PNC changed its terms. JPMorgan and Bank of America adopted similar policies in October, and Citizens emailed customers a warning
ChatGPT Wallet is open to Pro subscribers in the US. It pays through the major card networks with a token in place of the card number, and every purchase needs a security check such as Face ID
blocks agents that shop with a card number a customer hands them, the WSJ reported. Its payments arm is now in Visa's Agentic Ready program, which has 140-plus members

open.label: Missing numbers
open.text: No bank said how many customers connect agents to their accounts or how many losses involved them. No company has disclosed agent purchase counts.

chart.title: How a ChatGPT Wallet purchase works

sources.desc: Citi, PNC and other banks' new terms, Nov 18

sources.name: Payments Dive
sources.desc: The wallet launch and executives' outlook

sources.desc: Visa's program adds J.P. Morgan Payments

correction.text: We said Visa, Mastercard and Amex built ChatGPT Wallet with OpenAI, that every purchase needs a biometric check, and that Visa's 20% to 30% trust figure covered Singapore, Australia and Japan. Our sources say the wallet pays through the major card networks, each purchase needs a security check such as Face ID, and the figure is not broken out by country.

stories.headline: Walmart says Sparky use rose 129% and opens its store to outside agents with spending caps
stories.dek: Shoppers can cap what an approved third-party agent spends, track its orders and cut off its access.

facts.text: rise in US use of Sparky, Walmart's own shopping agent, from a year earlier, CEO John Furner said on the Nov 19 earnings call
larger baskets tied to Sparky use, Furner said
Walmart's new agent profiles let shoppers set permissions and spending limits for approved outside agents, track those purchases separately and revoke access
growth in Walmart US e-commerce in the quarter. Global e-commerce rose 17% and revenue 5.2%, to $188.8B

open.label: Missing numbers
open.text: Walmart gave no count of Sparky users or agent orders and did not name the approved outside agents. Its growth chief said it is still learning how conversational prompts change product discovery.

chart.title: Walmart, fiscal Q3, change from a year earlier

stories.headline: Anthropic opens misuse monitoring that keeps data in customers' clouds after a 100-firm beta
stories.dek: The system watches across many requests, since agents can split an attack into small steps that each look harmless.

facts.text: customers in the private beta, including Bridgewater, Salesforce and Stripe. It is now in public beta
prompts and replies stay in the customer's AWS or Google Cloud account, and neither Anthropic nor the cloud keeps them
for a customer's security team to review a flagged case, or it risks losing access
to use; customers pay their cloud provider for storage

open.label: Sources differ
open.text: TNW says Anthropic began keeping data for 30 days with Fable 5. PYMNTS says a June policy allowed 30 days, or up to two years for flagged logs.

stories.headline: Klarna becomes the first non-card way to pay when AI agents check out through Adyen
stories.dek: Merchants that already offer Klarna through Adyen can switch it on without new integration work.

facts.text: payment option other than cards on Adyen Agentic, which launched in June for large US merchants
active Klarna users, with more than 1.35 million merchants and 3.8 million transactions a day
Shoppers must confirm a purchase before it is processed, and can pay in full or in interest-free installments

open.label: Missing numbers
open.text: Neither company said how many agent checkouts run through Adyen Agentic or which merchants use it.
